applies_why: The judge text rules on the Matthew 1:20 clash by citing each side's competing answer, so it is a ruling on pressed witnesses governed by K-C.
quote: D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse: one reading requires integrated chain-and-footing analysis; the other allows an UNDERDETERMINED verdict from two sides competing answers to Matthew 1:20.
why: The judge labels the clash underdetermined from the challenger's covenant-presence answer and the defender's womb-source answer, which is not a chain-against-chain weighing by footing and leaves the required analysis undone.
